propositions: config.local_to_jira_status is an unpinned third independent literal copy of LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA that can drift without detection
Mutation of config.local_to_jira_status["deleted"] to a non-workflow value leaves all 59 tests passing, indicating no parity enforcement
The canonical status map is defined solely in adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py and read by both ACLI and Backend adapters via aliases
Importing jira_family into core config.py would invert declared one-way dependency layering and hide the operator-override kill-switch behind an adapter import
A parity test using the existing _load_attr helper can enforce dict-level equality between config.local_to_jira_status and the canonical map without importing the adapter
